gap: No result ChatGPT got says that UGREEN's 10Gbps CM691 sells for $40.99 on UGREEN's US store today, with $69.99 only as the struck-through price, while UGREEN's 5Gbps 'budget' USB 3.0 switch is $35.99 and out of stock there. That leaves the slow switch just $5 cheaper and not buyable, so it has no reason to be on the list.
standout_why: I compared against three rival pages. digitaldesksolutions.com (2026-10-28) gives only price tiers ('Budget', 'Mid', 'Premium') and no dollar amounts. pickslab.net (2026-03-12) gives no prices and has no 10Gbps model; its top pick is the 5Gbps IOGEAR GUS432. techwisereviews.com (2026-08-15) covers only video KVM docks, with no prices and nothing on USB-only switches for an SSD. The cited UGREEN product page shows the CM691 price but not the budget model's stock status, and it doesn't compare the two. ChatGPT's own chats disagreed on the price: two said $40.99, one said 'Listed $69.99', which is the compare-at price. All three chats offered the out-of-stock 5Gbps unit as the budget pick.
decides: This confirms the UGREEN CM691 as the pick and removes the 5Gbps 'budget' tier. For $5 more you get double the link speed (10 vs 5 Gbps), and the cheaper unit can't be bought at UGREEN US today anyway. For anyone who wants more, the step up is the UGREEN 2-in 7-out 10Gbps (about $76 on Amazon) or the Cable Matters 201160 ($50.99 on a special order taking 1–2 weeks). Both include or support an external power input. The ATEN US3342 is the only one with laptop charging pass-through (85 W), but I couldn't get a price from a page I opened, and ATEN's US page quotes it on request.
